title: Series Entertainment Brings Vibe-Gaming to Life with ‘RUN,’ An AI-Based Platform to Create Games and Shows (EXCLUSIVE)
content: The generative AI boom brought us “vibe coding,” and then eventually “vibe directing.” Now, a new entry: vibe…game development? It’s the idea behind Series Entertainment’s “RUN,” a new platform that lets users create new games while shortening the typically months- or yearslong window for building them down to days. The platform, which is now in beta, aims to […]
